name: usual-mail-cloudflare
description: Deploys Usual Mail's server to Cloudflare (wrangler.jsonc) and tests it in workerd. Each part keeps its own package in its folder.

scripts.check:cloudflare: node server/scripts/cloudflare-prepare.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.cloudflare.json && tsc --noEmit -p server/test/cloudflare/tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 server/test/cloudflare/*.test.ts
